node.statement: Left multiplication of the difference in node 1.3.2.2 by V^dagger has norm at most (1+epsilon)||V^dagger||*8*epsilon<24*epsilon, while V^dagger bold-dot V=J. Combining this with node 1.3.2.1 and (U bold-dot V)^dagger=V^dagger bold-dot U^dagger proves the 44*epsilon defect bound.
